notes.title: About the further development of the game
notes.content:
Good day, dear backroom fans! 
 
We are a team of indie developers from Ukraine, we are currently in a very difficult situation due to electrical problems, but this will not stop us from continuing to develop the game. 
 
Currently, we working on a large update for a game

notes.title: Version 0.6 - Added soul detector
notes.content:
The main feature is added a new item - a soul detector
this simplifies the task of finding soul pieces
also
 - improved ceil texture
 - removed the limit of souls in the inventory
 - reworked effect when the player was wounded

notes.title: Version 0.5 - New Feature
notes.content:
Added new feature
when a player dies completely, and there is still someone alive on the server, the deceased will now not exit the game but will appear in a new form
and other small changes

notes.title: Game improvement #1
notes.content:
Added and edited a very large number of different aspects of the gameplay
however, since you couldn't test the old version, there's no point in listing all the changes!

 - Updated and enlarged game map
 - Added chalk, shout system
 - Added localization, to be honest, the quality of the translation is poor
 - Improved chat with localization support (for system messages)
 - Added several new rooms
 - In general, you can already play the game, collect the necessary items
 - Added a key item so you can leave the backrooms (a piece of the soul)
 - Added several entities/creatures with different behaviors
 - Added a special system for some items that will tell you where to find a key item, but only at a certain distance and if you listen to the sounds
and a very, very large number of changes...
